blocks.text: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who has sanctified us with the sanctity of Aaron and commanded us to bless His people Israel in love.
May the Lord bless you from Zion, the creator of heaven and earth.
O Lord, our Master, how mighty is Thy Name over the whole earth.
Protect me, O Lord, for I trust in Thee.
May God be gracious to us and bless us, may He cause His countenance to shine with us, Selah.
The Lord, the Lord is a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and great in kindness and truth.
Turn towards me and be gracious to me for I am alone and poor.
Towards Thee, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
Behold just as the eyes of slaves are on the hand of their master and as the eyes of the handmaid are on the hand of her mistress, so are our eyes on the Lord our God until He will be gracious to us.
May he receive blessing from the Lord and kindness from the God of his salvation and find grace and favour in the eyes of God and man.
O Lord, be gracious to us, to Thee we hope, be their strength every morning as well as our help in time of trouble.

blocks.text: 148 מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 148
הכהנים יזהרו בנעילת מנעליהם שלא יגעו בם בידים ואם נגעו יחזרו ליטול ידיהם.

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
uncertainties: The lamed of לָּנוּ appears to have a dagesh.
I can't tell whether בְאוֹר (after כִּי) has a dagesh.

blocks.text: בְּסֵפֶר חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם:

וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי בִי יִרְבּוּ יָמֶיךָ וְיוֹסִיפוּ לְךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּים: לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים תִּכְתְּבֵנוּ: אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים. כָּתְבֵנוּ בְּסֵפֶר הַחַיִּים: כַּכָּתוּב וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּייָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּוֹם:
uncertainties: The divine name in בַּייָ has patah under ב and qamatz under the second yod. I can't tell whether the first yod has a sheva.
Response printed in the left column.

blocks.text: הַיּוֹם תְּקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵנוּ:

uncertainties: Optional line in small unpointed type, printed as part of the rubric line.

blocks.text: כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה תְּבִיאֵנוּ שָׂשִׂים וּשְׂמֵחִים בְּבִנְיַן שָׁלֵם. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וַהֲבִיאוֹתִים אֶל הַר קָדְשִׁי. וְשִׂמַּחְתִּים בְּבֵית תְּפִלָּתִי. עוֹלֹתֵיהֶם וְזִבְחֵיהֶם לְרָצוֹן
uncertainties: This sentence continues on the next page (s317 and later), which I wasn't given.
I'm not sure of the spelling of עוֹלֹתֵיהֶם (vav after the lamed or not).

page_completeness_notes: I transcribed every line from the header to the last line, which breaks off mid-sentence at לְרָצוֹן. The bottom of the page is blank.

notes: I read only the 14 listed images. I didn't open any repository file, OCR output or other transcription.

The images cover scans s312–s316 only. The request says every Hebrew word from s312 through s326 must be included, but s317–s326 weren't provided, so they aren't transcribed. s316 ends mid-sentence (…עוֹלֹתֵיהֶם וְזִבְחֵיהֶם לְרָצוֹן), and its continuation is on a page I wasn't given.
Using the stated convention, IA leaf = scan − 1: s312 → leaf 311, through s316 → leaf 315.
The divine name is printed as יְיָ (two yods, sheva and qamatz). I've transcribed it that way.
None of these pages contain Jerusalem or a defective-lamed form, so the special encoding rules didn't come up.

I give metegs only where I could see them. In the dense paragraphs, many possible metegs and some dageshes are below what the scan resolves, and the per-block uncertainties list them. I didn't add any from memory of the liturgy.
The alef-lamed ligature (ﭏ) on s312 is written as the letters אֶל.
No Biblical citation labels are printed on these pages. The only margin cue is רבש"ע on s312, which I classed as an instruction.

Priest/congregation pairing: on s312/s314 each priest's word in the right margin is a separate block (-kNN), immediately followed by its congregational verse (-cNN). The English pages s313/s315 use the same scheme. On s316 each היום line (-pNN) is followed by its אָמֵן response (-rNN).
